title: Home Comfort Financing Application Acceptance Standards
content:
A Home Comfort Financing application is taken only when every standard below is met.

## Standards

**A. Project.** An application is taken only for a Harbison installation project in signed or scheduled status. The status is read from the installation project record for the project being financed.

**B. Plan.** The plan applied for must be listed among that installation package's eligible financing plans.

**C. Amount.** The amount requested must be between the plan's smallest and largest amount financed, and must not exceed the project's contract price plus approved change orders, upgrades and accessories, less credits known at application.

**D. Reapplication after a decline.** A customer whose earlier application was declined may apply again only when the date of handling is more than the plan's reapplication wait (in calendar days) after that decline was decided. Reapply days are counted as calendar days with the decline's decision date as day 0. The decision date is read from the declined account's record for that customer.

**E. Co-applicant and prequalification.** A co-applicant may join where the plan allows a co-applicant, and a soft prequalification is offered first where the plan offers one.

**F. What the applicant states and what decides credit.** The applicant states their own income and consent. The credit decision rests on the bureau report, never on the applicant's own statement of their credit standing.

## Project status at a glance

| Installation project status | Application taken |
|---|---|
| signed | yes |
| scheduled | yes |
| any other status | no |

## Amount ceiling — illustration (hypothetical figures)

A project's contract price is $11200.00, an approved change order adds $650.00, and a credit of $400.00 is known at application. The amount requested may not exceed $11200.00 plus $650.00 less $400.00, that is $11450.00 — and must also lie within the plan's own smallest and largest amounts financed.

## Reapplication clock — boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-calendar-day wait)

The decline was decided on 1 March, which is day 0.

| Date of handling | Calendar day count | More than 30 days after the decline? | New application taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| 31 March | day 30 | no — equal, not more | no |
| 1 April | day 31 | yes | yes |

The comparison is strictly "more than": the day that equals the wait still falls inside it.
